claims.claim: 沼泽钥匙解决沉没墓穴（Sunken Crypts）入口问题
claims.evidence: 'They can only be accessed by unlocking the iron gate to the entrance by using the Swamp key dropped by The Elder. The Swamp Key is NOT consumed upon use.'

claims.claim: 沉没墓穴中的泥泞废料堆（Muddy scrap pile）可采集出铁屑（Scrap iron）等材料
claims.evidence: 'composed of multiple rooms separated by Muddy scrap piles, which can be mined with any pickaxe for Scrap iron, Leather scraps and Withered bones.'

claims.claim: 沼泽中的怪物几乎全部敌对，且常年下雨（角色持续处于 Wet 状态）
claims.evidence: 'every last creature here is hostile to the player'；'It is always raining in the mire regardless of the weather elsewhere; this means the player will always be Wet'

claims.claim: 沼泽的 Boss 是邪骨恶灵（Bonemass）
